title: Every original-circle-equivariant observation factors through the half-period source quotient

factorization.factor: There is a unique set map F_bar:X/H->H_ps with F=F_bar composed with pi_X.
factorization.well_defined_reason: K1716 proves F is constant on every H-orbit.
factorization.effective_action: Because C is abelian, H is normal and C/H=C_eff acts on X/H; F_bar is C_eff-equivariant.
factorization.topological_scope: For a topological C-space and continuous F, the same factor is continuous for the quotient topology by its defining universal property; no Hausdorff or manifold claim is added.

claim_ceiling: The exact mathematical receiver of any such observation is the source orbit quotient X/{1,z} with its induced effective-circle action. The theorem neither supplies X as a physical carrier nor selects the quotient in the source action.
